mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals severe labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 1%+ monthly increases in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust housing market expansion that drives broader consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST increase >1%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation (CPIAUCSL annual change < 2.0%) and low-rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) regimes, accommodative monetary policy supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of low-inflation, low-rate periods, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without specific triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 90 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of INDPRO < 90 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) combined with industrial production above 95 indicates synchronized demand-supply expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of GDPC1 growth >0 and INDPRO >95 instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.0%), labor market slack suppresses wage growth and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of UNRATE > 9.0 periods, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.
